status: pre-registered + amendment_1 committed (2026-08-13); external baselines done; internal-method step next

dataset.name: FinGLM 复赛A (MetaGLM/FinGLM public repo)
dataset.corpus: 11,588 annual reports (2019-2022), filenames byte-identical to FinGLM reports_list.csv; PDFs mirrored from ModelScope modelscope/chatglm_llm_fintech_raw_dataset allpdf/ (LFS), polite-paced REST download, Range-resumed, %PDF- magic verified
dataset.readonly: external data lives under D:/Engineering/FinPlanRAG/database only, read-only upstream; never modified in place

gold_standard.statement: FinGLM provides NO original gold document sets (audited: gold_document_sets=False). The per-question gold document set is DERIVED from the answer prompt metadata (ent_name + year -> the single annual report of that company/year). This is a SELF-BUILT evaluation convention and is declared as such; it is not an original dataset annotation.
gold_standard.derivation: prompt.ent_name matched to reports_list company full name (exact) -> code; prompt.year -> the (code, year) annual report; gold_doc_ids = [<code>_<year>_annual]
gold_standard.note: single-document closure: closure=1 means the unique gold document was retrieved within budget

exclusions.reporting: excluded cases are recorded with reasons in finglm_full_cases_v1.json and reported honestly; they are never silently dropped

temporal.cutoff_rule: cutoff = the report's announcement date (date field of reports_list.csv row); a document is visible iff available_at <= cutoff; the gold document's available_at == its own cutoff (always visible)

retrieval_interface.index: per-document single chunk (one annual report = one retrieval unit); BM25 formula IDENTICAL to LOFin's frozen baseline: idf = log(1 + (N - df + 0.5)/(df + 0.5)), k1=2.2, b=0.75, term-frequency formula identical, dedup by document
retrieval_interface.tokenizer: jieba (CJK words with len>=2 or digit strings); declared difference vs LOFin's English tokenizer, both are the frozen baselines' native tokenizers for their respective languages
retrieval_interface.obligation_rule: chinese_obligation_rule: first (20xx)年 in the question + longest alias (full name / short name / code) present in the question -> the single (code, year) annual report; filing_type=10-K, fiscal_period=FY (annual-report analogues)
retrieval_interface.path_markers: chunk terms include generic_path = path<code><year> and precise_path = path<code><year>fy10k, byte-identical construction to LOFin's make_period_chunks (fill_missing matches required_terms against them)

methods.note: the four external baselines are the same-named frozen baselines as in the LOFin benchmark; all run through retrieve_policy imported byte-identically from run_period_aware_baselines.py (language-agnostic policy reading only obligation fields + BM25 interface). Project-internal methods (v4/v8/v9 family) are a SEPARATE comparison run AFTER this protocol is committed, with zero tuning on FinGLM results.

metrics.closure: file-level: gold_doc_ids subset of used_docs (single gold doc -> gold retrieved within budget)
metrics.note: closure is FILE-LEVEL document closure, NOT answer accuracy; FinGLM answers are never scored. For single-gold-doc tasks closure reduces to recall; discriminating signal comes from wrong_doc_rate and the layered report.

statistics.pairwise_comparisons: McNemar on closure and paired permutation (sign-flip, seed 20260812, +1 pseudo-count) on wrong_doc_rate, identical procedure to the LOFin extended tests (audit_lofin_full_extended_tests.py)
statistics.claim_boundary: any claim of superiority is restricted to these pairwise tests on the declared metrics; no SOTA claim against external leaderboards (FinGLM original papers use answer-accuracy, which this protocol explicitly does not measure)

integrity.frozen_protocol_discipline: protocol changes must be committed before any run; the frozen method set is never tuned on FinGLM results
integrity.reporting: negative results reported; Chinese/English results kept separate; question text never reveals filing type to any method (the methods receive only the public question)
integrity.reproducibility: runners import the frozen LOFin policy code byte-identically (no copy-paste divergence)

amendment_1.title: Project-internal method step (v4/v9 family) - Chinese obligation rule and method matrix
amendment_1.pre_registered: protocol methods.note already declares the internal-method comparison as a SEPARATE run after this protocol was committed; amendment_1 pins down its exact obligations and retrieval matrix BEFORE any internal-method row is produced

obligation_rule_internal.name: chinese_internal_obligation_rule
obligation_rule_internal.differs_from_baseline_rule_by: the baseline chinese_obligation_rule (frozen for the four external baselines) takes the FIRST (20xx)year in the question; the internal-method rule takes ALL explicit (20xx)year occurrences -> one (code, year, 10-K, FY) obligation each, sorted by year. This is a faithful Chinese translation of the LOFin-internal select_years semantics (explicit-year branch keeps every explicit year; LOFin v4/v7/v8/v9 all carry their own obligation parser as part of the method definition, not tuned on FinGLM results).
obligation_rule_internal.range_semantics: X年至Y年 / 对比X年和Y年 -> the two explicit endpoint years {X, Y} (LOFin's explicit-range branch has no Chinese textual form: no concatenated 20xx20xx tokens; the '至/和' endpoints are the explicit years). 1829/1829 questions contain at least one (20xx)year; the no-year fallback branch is defensive only.
obligation_rule_internal.alias_matching: identical to the baseline rule: longest alias (full name / short name / code) present in the question
obligation_rule_internal.filing_analogue: every obligation is the annual report (filing_type=10-K, fiscal_period=FY) of (code, year), doc_id from the registry - identical to the baseline rule

method_matrix.finplan_v4: obligations = chinese_internal_obligation_rule; per (code, year) obligation query = question + code + year, required_terms=[generic_path=path<code><year>], limit=1, until budget. Byte-faithful to LOFin run_nonoracle_obligation_planning_v4 (finplan_v3_path_bound: leg query + generic path marker).
method_matrix.finplan_v9_cascade: obligations = chinese_internal_obligation_rule; per obligation query = question + code + year + FY + 10-K, required_terms=[precise_path], limit=1, until budget. Byte-faithful to LOFin run_nonoracle_obligation_planning_v7 finplan_v9_cascade.
method_matrix.metadata_v9_fill: P4 honesty comparator (same as LOFin): the EXACT SAME v9 obligations and query, metadata-decomposition retrieval (skip already-used doc_id, no cascade) - identical to FinGLM baseline period_metadata_decomposition retrieval on the same obligation; the only difference vs pmd is the obligation rule (all years vs first year).
method_matrix.v7_v8_equivalence_note: LOFin v7/v8 differ from v9 only in period_requests (quarter/half-year phrases, first-n, fiscal-year-N). FinGLM 复赛A questions contain NO quarter/half-year phrases (corpus is annual reports only; scanned 1829/1829), so v7/v8/v9 obligation rules coincide on this track and v9_cascade represents all three. v8's half-year alias layer has no ground here; stated honestly, not silently dropped.
method_matrix.single_run: v4, v9_cascade, metadata_v9_fill run in ONE process over the SAME corpus index (identical postings/dl, avgdl=55285), same cases, same budget=4, same cutoff semantics as the baseline run.

equivalence_checks.index_equality: rebuilt index must reproduce avgdl=55285 and unique-term count 1212588 (byte-identical construction as the baseline run)
equivalence_checks.single_year_consistency: on the 1783 single-year cases, finplan_v9_cascade has the same obligation and same retrieval as baseline period_metadata_decomposition -> closure/wrong_doc_rate must match row-for-row (asserted, not assumed)

amendment_1.no_tuning: no method is tuned on FinGLM results; the 46 multi-year cases (22 baseline pmd failures) are NOT used to change any rule; the all-years rule predates this analysis and is the LOFin-internal frozen semantics
amendment_1.claim_boundary: same as protocol statistics: pairwise McNemar closure + paired-permutation wrong_doc_rate, overall + 5 strata; no SOTA claim; file-level closure is not answer accuracy
